name: Intro to C#
description: A course about the basics of C#
about: This course is about the basics of C#

activities.title: Console Budget Tracker
activities.description: Build a C# console application that records income and expenses, validates input, and displays the current balance.

activities.title: Object-Oriented Library System
activities.description: Model books, members, and loans with classes, collections, and exception handling; include a short README with design decisions.

activities.title: C# Testing and Code Review
activities.description: Add automated tests to a provided C# service, identify defects through code review, and submit a corrected implementation with a concise review summary.

name: Advanced JavaScript
description: Deep dive into modern JavaScript patterns and ES6+
about: Master closures, async/await, modules, and design patterns in JavaScript.

activities.title: Asynchronous API Dashboard
activities.description: Build a dashboard that fetches data from two public APIs using async/await and handles loading, empty, and error states.

activities.title: Reusable Module Refactor
activities.description: Refactor a provided script into ES modules using closures and at least one appropriate design pattern; add unit tests for core behavior.

activities.title: JavaScript Performance Audit
activities.description: Profile a browser application, locate avoidable performance costs, and submit an optimized version with measurements demonstrating the improvement.

name: Python for Beginners
description: Learn Python syntax, data structures, and problem solving
about: Write clean Python scripts using variables, loops, functions, and OOP basics.

activities.title: Personal Expense Analyzer
activities.description: Write a Python program that reads expense data, groups it by category, and reports totals using functions and data structures.

activities.title: Command-Line Contact Book
activities.description: Create a menu-driven contact manager with input validation, file persistence, and clear separation between data and presentation logic.

activities.title: Python Automation Project
activities.description: Automate a repetitive file-processing workflow with Python, including command-line options, useful error messages, logging, and automated tests.

name: Java Fundamentals
description: Build a strong foundation in Java programming
about: Cover Java syntax, OOP, collections, and exception handling with hands-on labs.

activities.title: Inventory Management CLI
activities.description: Develop a Java console application using classes, interfaces, collections, and custom exceptions to manage store inventory.

activities.title: Order Processing Test Suite
activities.description: Implement an order-processing service and test normal, boundary, and failure cases with JUnit.

activities.title: Java Collections Case Study
activities.description: Select appropriate Java collection types for a scheduling problem, implement the solution, and justify the performance and design tradeoffs.

name: Full-Stack Web Development
description: Build complete web apps with frontend and backend skills
about: Learn HTML, CSS, React, and ASP.NET Core to ship production-ready web applications.

activities.title: Responsive Product Catalog
activities.description: Create an accessible responsive catalog UI with filtering, reusable components, and polished loading and empty states.

activities.title: Full-Stack Booking Capstone
activities.description: Build and document a booking application with a React client, ASP.NET Core API, relational persistence, validation, and authentication.

activities.title: Production Readiness Review
activities.description: Prepare the capstone for release by adding end-to-end tests, observability, deployment documentation, and a prioritized production-readiness checklist.

name: React Fundamentals
description: Learn React from scratch with hooks and component design
about: Build interactive UIs with React components, hooks, and state management.

activities.title: Component Library Challenge
activities.description: Build reusable Button, Modal, FormField, and Card components with documented props and accessible interactions.

activities.title: Task Board with Hooks
activities.description: Create a task board using hooks, derived state, form validation, filtering, and persistence in local storage.

activities.title: Accessible Data Explorer
activities.description: Build a React data explorer with search, sorting, pagination, keyboard navigation, and tests for important user interactions.

name: ASP.NET Core Web APIs
description: Design and build RESTful APIs with ASP.NET Core
about: Create secure, scalable Web APIs using controllers, EF Core, and authentication.

activities.title: Course Enrollment API
activities.description: Implement RESTful enrollment endpoints with DTO validation, correct status codes, EF Core relationships, and integration tests.

activities.title: Secure API Assessment
activities.description: Add JWT authentication and role-based authorization to an API, then document and test protected workflows.

activities.title: API Observability and Resilience
activities.description: Add structured logging, centralized exception handling, health checks, request tracing, and resilience behavior to an ASP.NET Core API.

name: iOS App Development with Swift
description: Create native iOS apps using Swift and SwiftUI
about: Design and ship iOS applications with Swift, SwiftUI, and Apple frameworks.

activities.title: SwiftUI Habit Tracker
activities.description: Build a SwiftUI habit tracker with reusable views, state management, validation, and local persistence.

activities.title: Weather App Prototype
activities.description: Create an iOS app that consumes a weather API, handles network failures, and presents an accessible adaptive interface.

activities.title: iOS Release Candidate
activities.description: Polish an iOS application for release with tests, accessibility improvements, error handling, app icons, and a concise App Store release note.

name: Android Development with Kotlin
description: Build Android apps with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose
about: Learn Kotlin, Android Studio, and Jetpack Compose to create modern mobile apps.

activities.title: Compose Expense Tracker
activities.description: Develop an expense tracker with Jetpack Compose, navigation, form validation, and a ViewModel-driven UI state.

activities.title: Offline Notes Application
activities.description: Build a notes app using Room and coroutines with create, edit, search, delete, and offline persistence workflows.

activities.title: Android Release Candidate
activities.description: Prepare an Android application release with UI tests, accessibility checks, offline error handling, and a signed-build workflow description.

name: Data Science with Python
description: Analyze data using Python, pandas, and visualization tools
about: Explore data wrangling, statistical analysis, and visualization with Python.

activities.title: Retail Data Cleaning Report
activities.description: Clean a messy retail dataset with pandas, document assumptions, and produce a reproducible notebook with quality checks.

activities.title: Exploratory Sales Dashboard
activities.description: Analyze sales trends and customer segments, then communicate findings through well-labeled visualizations and a concise executive summary.

activities.title: Reproducible Analysis Presentation
activities.description: Turn a completed analysis into a reproducible report and present three evidence-based recommendations to a nontechnical stakeholder.

name: Machine Learning Essentials
description: Introduction to supervised and unsupervised learning
about: Understand core ML algorithms, model evaluation, and practical pipelines.

activities.title: Customer Churn Baseline
activities.description: Prepare a churn dataset, train two classification models, and compare them using appropriate metrics and cross-validation.

activities.title: Clustering Analysis Brief
activities.description: Segment customers with an unsupervised method, justify feature preparation and cluster selection, and explain actionable findings.

activities.title: Model Risk and Monitoring Plan
activities.description: Evaluate a trained model for bias, drift, and operational failure modes, then propose measurable monitoring thresholds and response actions.

name: Deep Learning with Neural Networks
description: Build and train neural networks for real-world problems
about: Cover CNNs, RNNs, and transfer learning with hands-on coding projects.

activities.title: Image Classifier Experiment
activities.description: Train and evaluate a CNN image classifier, track experiments, inspect failure cases, and propose targeted improvements.

activities.title: Transfer Learning Capstone
activities.description: Fine-tune a pretrained model for a real dataset and submit reproducible code, evaluation metrics, and a model card covering limitations.

activities.title: Neural Network Error Analysis
activities.description: Perform systematic error analysis on a trained network, categorize failure patterns, and run one justified experiment that improves a selected weakness.

name: Ethical Hacking Basics
description: Learn penetration testing and secure coding fundamentals
about: Practice ethical hacking techniques, vulnerability scanning, and secure coding.

activities.title: Authorized Vulnerability Assessment
activities.description: Assess the provided lab target, record evidence safely, rank findings by risk, and recommend specific remediation steps.

activities.title: Secure Coding Remediation
activities.description: Identify and fix vulnerabilities in a sample application and demonstrate each correction with repeatable security tests.

activities.title: Incident Response Exercise
activities.description: Analyze a simulated security incident, construct a timeline, preserve relevant evidence, and write containment, eradication, and recovery recommendations.

name: SQL and Relational Databases
description: Master SQL queries, joins, and database design
about: Design schemas, write efficient queries, and manage relational databases.

activities.title: Normalized Library Database
activities.description: Design a normalized library schema with constraints, keys, an ER diagram, and seed data that demonstrates its relationships.

activities.title: Reporting Query Portfolio
activities.description: Write and explain queries using joins, aggregation, subqueries, CTEs, and window functions against the course dataset.

activities.title: Database Performance Clinic
activities.description: Diagnose slow queries using execution plans, add justified indexes, and report the performance impact without changing expected query results.

name: NoSQL with MongoDB
description: Store and query document data with MongoDB
about: Learn document modeling, aggregation pipelines, and indexing in MongoDB.

activities.title: Catalog Document Model
activities.description: Design a MongoDB model for a product catalog, justify embedding versus referencing, and provide representative documents.

activities.title: Analytics Aggregation Pipeline
activities.description: Build aggregation pipelines for business questions, create appropriate indexes, and compare query execution before and after indexing.

activities.title: MongoDB Reliability Review
activities.description: Add schema validation, backup guidance, index monitoring, and failure-handling recommendations to an existing MongoDB application design.

name: Cloud Computing with AWS
description: Deploy and manage applications on Amazon Web Services
about: Learn EC2, S3, Lambda, IAM, and cloud architecture best practices.

activities.title: Highly Available Web Architecture
activities.description: Design an AWS architecture for a resilient web application with networking, scaling, monitoring, security, and a cost estimate.

activities.title: Serverless Processing Pipeline
activities.description: Implement an event-driven processing workflow with managed AWS services, least-privilege IAM, logging, and deployment instructions.

activities.title: Cloud Cost and Security Review
activities.description: Review an AWS workload for cost and security risks, prioritize findings, and propose changes supported by estimated impact and AWS best practices.

name: DevOps and CI/CD Pipelines
description: Automate builds, tests, and deployments with modern DevOps tools
about: Use Docker, GitHub Actions, and infrastructure as code to streamline delivery.

activities.title: Quality-Gated CI Pipeline
activities.description: Create a pipeline that restores dependencies, runs tests and static analysis, builds an artifact, and blocks merges on failure.

activities.title: Staged Deployment Workflow
activities.description: Design a deployment pipeline with environment configuration, approvals, health checks, rollback behavior, and release documentation.

activities.title: Pipeline Incident Retrospective
activities.description: Diagnose a failed deployment from supplied logs, repair the pipeline, and write a blameless retrospective with concrete prevention actions.

name: Docker and Kubernetes
description: Containerize apps and orchestrate them at scale
about: Build images with Docker and deploy workloads with Kubernetes.

activities.title: Production-Ready Container
activities.description: Containerize an application with a multi-stage build, non-root runtime user, health check, and documented local workflow.

activities.title: Kubernetes Service Deployment
activities.description: Deploy the application with ConfigMaps, Secrets, probes, resource limits, scaling, and a repeatable rollout and rollback procedure.

activities.title: Kubernetes Operations Drill
activities.description: Investigate an unhealthy Kubernetes workload using events and logs, restore service, and document diagnosis, remediation, and prevention steps.

name: Software Engineering Principles
description: Apply SOLID, design patterns, and agile practices
about: Learn clean code, architecture, testing strategies, and team collaboration.

activities.title: Architecture Decision Record
activities.description: Evaluate two architectural approaches for a realistic feature and write an ADR explaining context, tradeoffs, and consequences.

activities.title: Legacy Code Refactoring
activities.description: Refactor a supplied module using SOLID principles while preserving behavior with characterization and unit tests.

activities.title: Team Design Review
activities.description: Review a proposed system design for maintainability, testing, security, and scalability, then provide prioritized, actionable engineering feedback.

name: Algorithms and Data Structures
description: Solve problems with arrays, trees, graphs, and sorting
about: Practice coding interviews and algorithmic thinking with real problems.

activities.title: Performance Benchmark Lab
activities.description: Implement and benchmark multiple search and sorting algorithms, then explain observed time and space behavior.

activities.title: Route Planner Challenge
activities.description: Model a transport network as a graph and implement a shortest-path solution with tests for disconnected and edge-case inputs.

activities.title: Algorithm Selection Report
activities.description: Solve the same realistic problem with two algorithmic approaches, benchmark both, and recommend one based on measured constraints and tradeoffs.

name: TypeScript for Developers
description: Add strong typing and safer patterns to JavaScript projects
about: Learn types, interfaces, generics, and TypeScript tooling for real apps.

activities.title: Typed API Client
activities.description: Build a type-safe API client using interfaces, generics, discriminated unions, and robust error handling.

activities.title: Strict Mode Migration
activities.description: Migrate a JavaScript module to strict TypeScript, remove unsafe types, and document how the type system prevented likely defects.

activities.title: Type-Safe Form Workflow
activities.description: Implement a validated form workflow with TypeScript, typed server responses, exhaustive error handling, and tests covering success and failure paths.

name: Git and Version Control
description: Collaborate effectively with Git branching and workflows
about: Master commits, branches, merges, pull requests, and team Git workflows.

activities.title: Collaborative Feature Workflow
activities.description: Complete a simulated feature using branches, focused commits, a pull request, review feedback, and a clean merge history.

activities.title: Merge Conflict Recovery Lab
activities.description: Resolve a multi-file conflict, explain each decision, recover a deliberately lost commit with reflog, and document the commands used.

activities.title: Release Management Simulation
activities.description: Create and tag a release from a shared repository, produce a changelog, apply a hotfix, and document the branching and recovery workflow.
